requirement: a pending class-C call is visible and answerable inline, the three folder lists collapse after three rows, and the folder lists file is MAC-signed and read-only so an external edit is detected and fails closed until the operator resets

assertions.inline_prompt: GpwPrompt is mounted on conversation.input.left (id w2m-gpw-prompt): pending count + tool name + allow/deny/open-panel; the launcher shows a badge too
assertions.collapsed_lists: whitelist / blacklist / recently intercepted each show 3 rows, then "另有 N 个，展开/收起" with per-list state
assertions.signing: v2 HMAC-SHA256 covers both lists; key from foldersKey config / W2M_GPW_FOLDERS_KEY / sidecar *.key (0600); atomic tmp->rename write then 0444 read-only
assertions.tamper_fail_closed: missing / unreadable / bad-MAC / unsigned-after-seen -> tampered: every path-bearing call is denied (409 in clients) until POST /api/w2m/gpw/reset re-signs
assertions.legacy_migration: an unsigned pre-1.7.9 file is migrated once, then treated as tampered if it reappears
assertions.tests: test/gpw-hardening.test.mjs 8/8; test/gpw-tamper-gate.test.mjs 4/4; test/gpw-persistence.test.mjs 5/5; gpw-activation 4/4; gpw-folder-policy 9/9; client-bundle 26/26; claims/installed-version/acceptance-doc pass
assertions.pack: scripts/pack.mjs builds the tarball deterministically; the canonical sha256 is published on the GitHub Release asset and verified equal to the npm tarball after release
assertions.list_inheritance: lists and MAC key live under $DSH_HOME/xclient (outside the plugin package): upgrades, restarts and uninstall/reinstall reuse the same signed file; only explicit panel actions (remove row / reset) change the lists — covered by test/gpw-persistence.test.mjs
